description: This file defines the AOW_WorkFlow class for managing workflows within SuiteCRM. It includes methods for loading, executing, and managing workflow conditions and actions, as well as querying and filtering beans based on complex conditions.

classes.name: AOW_WorkFlow
classes.description: Class for managing workflow logic in SuiteCRM, including condition evaluation, flow execution, and action processing.

methods.name: getSQLOperator
methods.description: Returns the SQL operator associated with a given key.

methods.name: isSQLOperator
methods.description: Checks if a given key corresponds to a valid SQL operator.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the workflow object and loads flow beans.

methods.name: bean_implements
methods.description: Checks if the class implements a specific interface (e.g., ACL).

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the workflow, including its conditions and actions.

methods.name: mark_deleted
methods.description: Marks the workflow and its linked beans as deleted.

methods.name: load_flow_beans
methods.description: Loads available modules for workflow flow definitions.

methods.name: run_flows
methods.description: Retrieves and runs all active workflows.

methods.name: run_flow
methods.description: Executes the flow's actions for all relevant beans.

methods.name: run_bean_flows
methods.description: Runs all applicable workflows for a specific bean.

methods.name: get_flow_beans
methods.description: Retrieves beans that match the workflow's conditions.

methods.name: build_flow_custom_query_join
methods.description: Builds a custom join for related modules.

methods.name: build_flow_relationship_query_join
methods.description: Builds relationship joins for workflow queries.

methods.name: build_flow_query_where
methods.description: Builds WHERE clauses for flow condition evaluation.

methods.name: build_query_where
methods.description: Builds the WHERE clause based on a condition, module, and query array.

methods.name: check_valid_bean
methods.description: Checks if a bean meets the workflow's trigger conditions.

methods.name: compare_condition
methods.description: Compares two values based on an operator.

methods.name: check_in_group
methods.description: Checks if a bean belongs to a security group.

methods.name: run_actions
methods.description: Executes all actions associated with the workflow for a given bean.
